syllabus_topics: Descriptive explanation and understanding of the use of fundamental and derived units, symbols, and numbers (irrational, complex numbers, etc.)
Uses theoretical and applied knowledge in mathematics, natural sciences, and their own fields together for engineering solutions.
Identifies, defines, formulates, and solves engineering problems, selects and applies appropriate analytical methods and modeling techniques for this purpose.
Selects and uses modern techniques and tools necessary for engineering applications.
Designs experiments, conducts experiments, collects data, analyzes and interprets results.
Works effectively individually and in multidisciplinary teams.
Accesses information and conducts resource research for this purpose, uses databases and other information sources.
Is aware of the necessity of lifelong learning; follows developments in science and technology and continuously renews oneself.
Analyzes and designs a system, system component, or process under realistic constraints to meet desired requirements; applies modern design methods in this direction.
Communicates effectively verbally and in writing; uses a foreign language at least at B1 General Level of the European Language Portfolio.
Is aware of the universal and societal impacts of engineering solutions and applications; is aware of entrepreneurship and innovation issues and has knowledge about contemporary problems.
Awareness of project management, workplace practices, employee health, environmental and occupational safety issues; awareness of the legal consequences of engineering practices.
institution: Düzce University — Elektrik-Elektronik Mühendisliği (Electrical-Electronics Engineering), Normal Öğretim
